name: Lunar Current Labyrinth
introDiscord: The Lunar Current pours into a moonglass labyrinth where every wall bends the water somewhere unexpected. Reflections point in conflicting directions, currents cross through solid-looking glass, and an eel slips through one corridor only to appear behind you.
introTwitch: The Lunar Current pours into a moonglass labyrinth where every wall bends the water somewhere unexpected. Reflections point in conflicting directions, currents cross through solid-looking glass, and an eel slips through one corridor only to appear behind you.

moonflow-intake.prompt: Three glass-lined corridors split around an engraved intake. Blue currents point toward all three simultaneously. Somewhere inside the walls, a Lunar Current Eel watches you make your first mistake.

left.message: Shizuki wedged a field kit beside the only railing that seems permanently attached to reality. Its bottle reads: "Current-root tonic. Hold the rail before drinking. No, seriously."
left.fullHpMessage: The tonic stays closed. You are healthy enough to experience the labyrinth's nonsense without medicinal assistance.

right.message: A Lunar Current Eel shoots through the corridor, disappears through a reflected wall, and reappears beside you. It pauses just long enough to look smug before attacking.

forward.message: A Moonkeeper cache sits at the end of a perfectly straight corridor. Suspiciously straight. You walk toward it, somehow circle the room twice, and eventually reach it from behind. Inside are Star Candies.

spiral-channel.prompt: The corridor curls around itself until the floor, walls, and ceiling all seem equally plausible. Three exits rotate beneath shifting lunar reflections while an eel repeatedly takes the route you were about to choose.

left.message: A moon-shell coffer is visible behind one pane of moonglass. Unfortunately, so are five reflections of it. After opening two fake cupboards and one very offended clam, you finally locate the real coffer and Star Candies.

right.message: A crooked Shizuki arrow points toward a survival cache. The bottle reads: "The labyrinth cheats. This bottle cheats back." Someone has added beneath it: "Still lost though."
right.fullHpMessage: You don't need the tonic. Shizuki's seventeen scratched-out arrows nearby may be more concerning.

forward.message: An eel flashes through three reflections at once. Two vanish. The third charges. You have no idea whether you picked the real one or it picked you.

tideglass-junction.prompt: Moonglass fins hum around a junction where three currents pull with exactly equal force. Shizuki's old directional markings cover nearly every surface. None agree.

left.message: A Lunar Current Eel loops around one fin, slips through another, and emerges directly across your path as though arriving for a scheduled appointment.

right.message: A Fae offering vessel floats perfectly between three competing currents. Every attempt to reach it sends it somewhere else. Eventually the currents cancel each other out long enough for you to claim Star Candies.

forward.message: One Berry pins down Shizuki's seventeenth map correction. The compass rose has been violently crossed out and replaced with: "NORTH KNOWS WHAT IT DID."

boss-antechamber.name: Coilheart Conduit
boss-antechamber.prompt: The labyrinth's passages finally converge around a vast rotating conduit. Currents spiral through transparent walls in impossible knots, all orbiting one enormous shadow moving effortlessly through them.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every current in the labyrinth suddenly reverses.

The moonglass walls flare blue as a massive shape coils through passage after passage without touching a single wall.

Whatever has been making the labyrinth look easy has finally noticed you.

Use /yes to enter the conduit or /no to accept that the labyrinth wins this round.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every current in the labyrinth suddenly reverses.

The moonglass walls flare blue as a massive shape coils through passage after passage without touching a single wall.

Whatever has been making the labyrinth look easy has finally noticed you.

Use !yes to enter the conduit or !no to accept that the labyrinth wins this round.
bossRetreatText: You back away from Coilheart Conduit. The currents resume their impossible routes, and the labyrinth seems unbearably pleased with itself.

boss.revealText: A colossal eel erupts through a ring of moonglass, currents twisting around its body like ribbons. The Lunar Current Coil has arrived!

completionText: The Lunar Current Coil disappears into the deepest channel, and the labyrinth finally stops rearranging itself long enough to reveal a clear exit. Shizuki's map is still completely wrong.
